scope: Each generated project is JSON serialized and parsed through the same structural import normalizer used by the app before validation, mapped schematic I/O checks, and documented scenarios through the schematic input path, PLC scan, and connected digital or scalar analog output. Every documented scenario must have a supported output path and pass. This import-normalized project-model round-trip is not a browser-storage UI test. Scalar analog wiring carries tag values only; it does not simulate voltage/current physics. Floating-terminal warnings apply to required connections; unmapped I/O channels and unused junction/distribution taps are excluded. Manufacturer hardware, electrical code, physical wiring, component layout quality, and safety are not certified.

caseEncoding.logic: logicPassBits uses testCases order from src/examples.js (1=pass, 0=fail)
caseEncoding.electrical: electricalPassBits uses BOOL input tag order (pressed cases), then BOOL output tag order (off then on); 1=pass, 0=fail
caseEncoding.integration: integrationPassBits follows testCases order; 1=pass, 0=fail, -=not applicable to a wired output model
